title: Amalricke
summary: Raleigh names Amalricke in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Amalricke, also written Almaricke and Almericke, King of Ierusalem, who warred in Aegypt and aided the Soldan Sanar against the Turkes. The three spellings are one man. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXVI, §. I, sig. 355a
